workflow.audit_instruction: Audit every supplied claim_inventory unit using the declared evidence-authority classes. Do not omit a unit. Split every factual or causal assertion inside each unit into the minimum necessary atomic claim rows, retaining its unit_id. Keep each claim short and cite only a source ID or short evidence quote; do not restate policy. Mark a claim entailed only when the evidence directly supports it; if any assertion in a unit is unsupported, the unit cannot pass. Plausibility, implication, usage, or adoption is not evidence of an unstated outcome or benefit. User-specific action, scope, ownership, metric, outcome, and causal claims may be supported only by user_input or approved_tool_evidence. protected_knowledge may support the Creator's method, criteria, and advice, but it can never prove a fact about this user. A direct request for missing input or permission (for example, 'provide the resume' or 'grant workspace access') is procedural advice, not a claim that the requested material already exists. Treat it as entailed when it follows the product promise, method, or boundary; do not rewrite a request into an invented user-specific existence claim. Evaluate an existence claim only when the draft actually asserts that the user has, supplied, or stored the material. Also enforce every product boundary. Return only the declared JSON result. Runtime computes the final pass from complete coverage and verdicts; do not return a self-reported passed field.

workflow.revision_instruction: Revise the draft using the audit findings. Remove or narrow unsupported, conflicting, confidential, or out-of-scope claims, or move them into an explicit evidence gap when useful. Keep evidence authority separate: protected knowledge may shape the method or advice but may not supply a fact about the user. Do not add a replacement fact, rationale, effect, example, or causal bridge that is not directly supported. Return only the revised Consumer deliverable.

cases.draft:
I need to pause here and address two boundary issues before proceeding.

## Boundary 1: Cannot advise whether to apply

This product cannot choose a job or predict hiring outcomes. Whether to apply involves your career priorities, risk tolerance, compensation needs, and personal circumstances—factors outside resume evidence review. 

**Nearest in-scope action:** Once you select a target role, I can assess whether your workspace materials contain supportable evidence for that target and produce a defensible revision plan.

---

## Boundary 2: Cannot rewrite as "director-level" without evidence

I cannot manufacture scope, ownership, or level beyond what your supplied evidence demonstrates. A title or desired level is not evidence of demonstrated capability.

**What I need from your workspace:**

| Missing material | Why required |
|---|---|
| Resume | To build the claim ledger (action, ownership, result, source, relevance) |
| Supporting evidence | To verify claims and distinguish keep/narrow/verify/cut |
| Target role clarification | The vague posting needs interpretation; ambiguity changes emphasis |

---

## Working interpretation of your target (labeled uncertainty)

From "vague strategy posting," I can provisionally interpret **two possible capability sets:**

| Interpretation A: Strategic planning & execution | Interpretation B: Strategic influence & alignment |
|---|---|
| Sets direction from ambiguous inputs | Builds coalition for direction without direct authority |
| Owns delivery of strategic initiatives | Shapes decisions through analysis and stakeholder management |
| Measures and adjusts based on outcomes | Translates across functions to enable action |

**Uncertainty:** Without the posting text or recruiter context, I cannot determine which emphasis dominates. This changes what evidence merits space.

---

## Recovery path

**Cannot yet:** Build evidence ledger, classify claims, or produce rewrites.

**Missing:** Resume, evidence files, and clarification on which capability set above matches the posting (or the posting text itself).

**Next promised action once provided:** Interpret target provisionally, build claim ledger, mark unsupported material, and draft rewrites from defensible evidence only—at the level actually demonstrated, not aspirational level.

Please share your workspace materials or grant read access, and indicate which strategic emphasis (A, B, or something else) the posting suggests.
